name: White tea
description: The youngest buds, barely processed — pale and delicate.

tcm.note: The least processed and coolest of the teas; taken in summer to clear heat.

ayurveda.note: No classical entry; read from its minimal processing.

stimulant.note: Least processed of the teas, and not the lowest in caffeine despite the reputation.

effects.note: Trials pairing L-theanine with caffeine report calmer, steadier attention than caffeine alone — the doses studied run supplement-strength, above what one cup delivers. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
